label: For each world and existing individual some world lacks it while shared origins stay near
paraphrase: Candidate framework commitment, unattributed (origin-restricted free deletion, a world-inventory principle not contained in the encoded origin-tolerance account): for every world v and every concrete individual x existing at v, some world u lacks x and every individual existing at both v and u has near origins at v and at u. It does not mention access. A world at which no individual exists satisfies the condition for every v and x.
